gloss: main argument; main discussion; the body (of a discourse)

definitions.gloss: main argument; main discussion; the body of a discourse
definitions.explanation: The central part of an argument, essay, or speech, as opposed to the introduction or digressions; also the main point one wishes to make. Common in academic and formal writing.

examples.japanese: {本論|ほんろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: to get to the main point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前置|まえお}き→前置き：07704_maeoki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧くらいにして、{本論|ほんろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}ろう→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: Enough preamble; let's move on to the main discussion.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本論|ほんろん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The body of this paper discusses three causes in detail.

notes:
Combines {本|ほん} (main, principal) + ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, discussion). The core part of a discussion or essay, distinct from the introduction or side topics; also the main point itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本論|ほんろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get to the main subject
- {本論|ほんろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧: to move on to the main discussion
- {本論|ほんろん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to stray from the main point

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{序論|じょろん}→序論：23169_joron⟧: introduction — the opening section that precedes the {本論|ほんろん}
- ⟦{結論|けつろん}→結論：02704_ketsuron⟧: conclusion — the closing section that follows it
